# DobDex

> Exit-liquidity venue for tokenized real-world assets (RWA) on Stellar (Soroban, **testnet**): a holder opens an exit, Liquidity Nodes price it, settlement lands in USDC. Part of the Dob Protocol stack (DOB Validator scores assets, Token Studio tokenizes them, DobDex lets holders sell).

The app has no backend for trading: every read is a Soroban RPC call and every write is a transaction the user signs with their own wallet (Freighter). An agent can read the same contracts directly; writing requires a Stellar testnet account that signs its own transactions. There is no API key and nothing to authenticate against on this site.

## Pages

- [Landing](https://dex.dobprotocol.com/): what DobDex is and who it is for
- [How the protocol works](https://dex.dobprotocol.com/protocol.html): exits, Liquidity Nodes, risk tiers, settlement
- [App](https://dex.dobprotocol.com/app.html): open an exit, back one as a Liquidity Node, claim USDC (needs Freighter on testnet)

## Network

- Network: Stellar testnet, passphrase `Test SDF Network ; September 2015`
- Soroban RPC: https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org
- Explorer: https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet

## Read endpoints (public, JSON, no auth; rate-limited per IP, 429 + Retry-After)

- [GET /exit-layer.json](https://dex.dobprotocol.com/exit-layer.json): snapshot of the Soroban exit layer (contracts, ledger coverage, exits, Liquidity Node stats), rewritten every 5 minutes
- [GET /api/validated-pools?networks=1301](https://dex.dobprotocol.com/api/validated-pools?networks=1301): tokenized pools that passed DOB Validator, with certificate scores
- [GET /api/activity?wallet=0x…&limit=50](https://dex.dobprotocol.com/api/activity): swaps, redeems and LP events of the legacy EVM app (Unichain Sepolia), newest first
- [GET /api/swaps?wallet=0x…&chainId=1301&limit=50](https://dex.dobprotocol.com/api/swaps): swap history of the legacy EVM app
- [GET /api/oracle-updates?tokenId=…&chainId=1301](https://dex.dobprotocol.com/api/oracle-updates): oracle price history
- [GET /api/health](https://dex.dobprotocol.com/api/health): liveness

Writes to `/api/swaps`, `/api/redeems` and `/api/lp-events` are only accepted for a transaction that is already on-chain, succeeded, was sent by the reported wallet and targets a DobDex contract; `/api/oracle-updates` writes are internal.
